name: Downward Dog

instructions.description: Start on hands and knees with your hands slightly in front of your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back to form an inverted V shape.
Press the floor away through the hands and lengthen the spine while keeping a soft bend in the knees if needed.
Breathe steadily, then lower back to all fours with control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold at a comfortable stretch intensity.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Keep the knees down to reduce hamstring demand while stretching the shoulders.

commentsNotes: Prioritize a long spine over straight knees.
Do not force the heels to the floor.
